study type: Secondary analysis of Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys
cohort: 9147 women aged 15-49 years who had a facility delivery in Ghana, Malawi, or Eswatini
finding: Delivery in Ghana or Eswatini and delivery in a government hospital were independently associated with a shorter length of stay after childbirth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with increased length of stay after childbirth.
